newsitem.title: FINLAND: CS FIRST BOSTON MAINTAINS BUY FOR CULTOR.
newsitem.headline: CS FIRST BOSTON MAINTAINS BUY FOR CULTOR.

text.p: Investment bank CS First Boston in a research note date November 19 maintained its buy stance for shares in Finnish foodstuffs group Cultor Oy.
The share prices quoted in in the note were 225 markka for Cultor I and 222 markka for Cultor II and the series on at noon on Monday traded at 216 and 215 markka respectively.
CS First Boston said its price target was 260 markka.

"We believe that the accumulation of problems in 1996 does not jeopardise the growth story, which will materialise in an EPS jump to FIM 15.7 (+36%) in 1997 and FIM 18.6 (+19%) in 1998, on our estimates," the bank said.
It said its medium term growth forecast for earnings per share was 13 percent, clearly above the food industry average, whereas the valuation was below the industry average.
